stepSummaries:
1. Spotlight: ⌘+Space + menu-bar magnifier; filter apps/files; Enter launches the selected app; quick math (e.g. 2+2→4). [verified]
  2. Control Center: top-right toggle; glassy panel with Dark Mode (applies app-wide), Brightness, Volume, Wi-Fi/Bluetooth/Focus toggles. [verified]
  3. Launchpad: full-screen blurred app grid; search filters icons; click opens the app and exits. [verified]
  4. Mission Control: window overview with the Tahoe glass-pane descend animation (Framer Motion); click a window to focus it. [verified]
  5. Notification Center: right-edge widgets (clock, weather) + a notifications list. [verified]
  6. Phase build+lint; manual check that all 5 overlays open/close and function. [verified]
